[[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], was '''subjugated''' by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="GG12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref> The Dressellians fought back against their oppressors using [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]]-supplied provisions.<ref name="CCG-DC">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Dresselian Commando}}</ref>
